original: The farmhouse and everything in it, the feast, the family's characters (every hairstyle, hat, outfit, pair of glasses and beard), the chalkboard, the cornucopia, the TV's parade and game, the fire, the wishbone, the old snapshots on the wall, the story and all of the code were made for this card. The parade balloons on the TV are our own designs.

blender.name: The feast
blender.detail: turkey, glazed ham, pies (pumpkin, apple, pecan), rolls, bread board, cranberry sauce, gravy boat, mashed potatoes, green beans, sweet potatoes, mac & cheese, stuffing, salad, corn, deviled eggs, a fruit bowl, butter, a pitcher of cider, and dinner on every plate · art/blender/scripts/thanksgiving_props.py

blender.detail: porch and front door with its wreath, the long table, chairs, place settings, candles, windows, sideboards, china hutch, bookshelf, armchair, side table and lamp, plants, wall clock, bench and coat hooks, blanket basket, horn of plenty, plaid sofa, console TV, fireplace, welcome easel, the family camera · same script
